I took the deal and put just enough money in my account to cover the amount for the discounted monthly. I didn’t realize they only offered the discount towards my NEXT billing cycle next month and Apple Pay didn’t show me how much they were trying to bill me, so when I tried my card for the monthly, it declined and instead took money for the last few classes I had to late cancel when emergencies with my health kept coming up. I am beside myself at their billing practice and cancelling my membership ON THEIR ACCORD, NOT MINE while I was confused."
